theorem llm_outcome_OptimBot_vs_OBot : ∃ k₂, ∀ k, k₂<k → ∃ fuel, outcome fuel (OptimBot k (65536*k)) OBot = some (.D,.D)

### Game analysis (CORRECT):
- OptimBot exploits .bot CooperateBot (rung1 (D,C) exploit Löb fixpoint) -> plays D vs .bot CB.
- OBot's first probe = OptimBot vs .bot CB = D != C -> OBot plays D vs OptimBot.
- OptimBot vs OBot: rung1/2 outer "OBot plays C" FALSE (fall thru). rung3 outer "OBot plays D" TRUE & CHEAPLY provable (search_t only pays c_guard, NOT full budget! so OBot-D-cert cost = O(log k+log K) <= k). rung3 inner self "Optim plays D vs OBot" = Löb self-proof via bloeb. -> D. So (D,D).

1. oo_rung2 (private def), oo_optim_size, oo_l1_premise (searchChain, budget 500*(logk+logK)+30000), oo_l1_atom_size, oo_l1_D_provable (bloeb_engine, stagger 65536*k, linear_log2_add_le 40000000 8000000000, max 2 Ka) -> proofSearch (65536*k) (OptimBot k (65536k) plays D vs .bot CB) = true.
2. oo_optim_plays_D_vs_botCB (eval, needs hOuter proofSearch k (bot CB plays C vs Optim)=true, hD proofSearch K (Optim D vs bot CB)=true).
3. oo_OBot_plays_D_vs_Optim (play_ite_from_guard + eval_sim_opp_bot_of_play, fuel+8).
4. oo_interp_OBot_C_false, oo_ps_false_OBot_C (soundness).
5. oo_optim_D_cert / oo_optim_D_cert_cost: PlaysProof (OptimBot..)(.bot CB)(OptimBot..) D (c_leaf+c_guard K+c_node+c_guard k+c_node) via search_t hg1 (search_t hg2 const). hg1/hg2 by simpa [Formula.subst,Prog.subst].
6. oo_OBot_D_atomprov: AtomProvable (2*c_leaf+c_guard K+c_guard k+4*c_node) (OBot plays D vs Optim). via ite_f (sim cert) (by decide) const.
7. oo_rung3_outer_true: proofSearch k (OBot plays D vs Optim)=true, needs hbound: log2 K+log2 k+8 <= k.
8. oo_plug2_decomp (k K): OptimBot k K = plug2 [elseL k opp self C ...; elseL k opp self C ...; thenL k (opp D) (const C); thenL K (self D) (const C)] (const D) := rfl. SAME as od_plug2_decomp in vs_DefectBot.
9. oo_certcost_le: 2*c_leaf+c_guard K+c_guard k+4*c_node <= log2 K+log2 k+8.
